title: DogTag rabies-vaccination credential v1
description: Gated on type containing RabiesVaccinationCertificate (NOT on recordType - this is a deliberate asymmetry inherited from packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/schema.ts, where isRabies = type.includes('RabiesVaccinationCertificate') while every other record type below gates on the recordType field instead). Mirrors the VACCINATION branch of validateSchema.

x-validationRules.description: microchip.implantDate must be <= vaccinationDate. Cross-field date comparison; JSON Schema has no date-arithmetic keyword to express it.
Animal age at vaccination (vaccinationDate - credentialSubject.dateOfBirth) must be >= 12 weeks. Cross-field date arithmetic.
covers: animal age at vaccination must be >= 12 weeks

x-validationRules.description: When series == "primary", validFrom must equal vaccinationDate + 21 days exactly. Cross-field date arithmetic conditioned on a sibling enum value.
covers: primary series: validFrom must == vaccinationDate + 21 days

x-validationRules.description: titer.resultIUml, an arbitrary-precision Decimal-tagged STRING (never a JSON number, per the leaf-commitment spec's float ban), must be numerically >= "0.5". JSON Schema's minimum/maximum only operate on the number type, not on decimal strings, so this magnitude comparison cannot be expressed structurally; the shape check (must look like a decimal string) IS expressed via this schema's titer.resultIUml pattern.
titer.sampledAt must be >= vaccinationDate + 30 days. Cross-field date arithmetic.

resultIUml.description: Shape only (decimal-string form). Magnitude (>= "0.5") is x-validationRules rabies-titer-magnitude.

titer.description: Optional. schema.ts also accepts this identical object at credentialSubject.titer instead (root-level titer takes precedence when both are present: schema.ts's own `c.titer !== undefined ? c.titer : subject.titer`). Both locations are declared structurally here via the shared $defs/titer definition, so a shape violation at either location is caught the same way.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional for this record type: schema.ts requires dateOfBirth only when recordType == DOG_PROFILE; the rabies branch merely USES it, when present, for the 12-week minimum-age rule (x-validationRules rabies-min-age-12-weeks). When present, must not be null.

titer.description: The alternate location schema.ts accepts for the same titer object described on the root-level titer property above.
